source.title: Water and rice in early Java and Bali
source.role: Dated rice presence in a named cultivated landscape; no yield or acreage target

records.source_locator: PDF pp. 249 and 256; printed pp. 240 and 247
records.geographic_basis: Named Malang uplands mapped explicitly to the existing malang location; not expanded to all Java or to neighbouring locations. This is a landscape-name crosswalk, not archaeological point geolocation or a measured field polygon.
records.interpretation: Early rice cultivation and the 891 charter concerning conversion to wet fields on the Malang-coast route attest rice availability. Both rice water-mode keys represent presence of the rice crop; actual irrigation and suitable hectares remain separate physical constraints. No double harvest; the chapter reports no documented double rice cropping before the fifteenth century.
